regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-tiered rotation led by Gold Miners (eligible, durable, broad breadth) with Silver & Royalties close behind; leadership is precious-metals concentration but NOT a one-narrative, directional regime (absorption 0.31, directional false). Oil & Gas is crowded (z=1.2) but the trend-gate discipline is validated on this market's history (gate_helps true), so the primary edge here is drawdown control rather than return forecasting. Track record n=66 with dir_accuracy 0.333 says directional calls have been weak historically; default to low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching Big Banks (rank 5, eligible, Hurst trend, breadth 0.286) — the one non-metals eligible theme with a trend tag. If breadth rises above 0.5 while it retains eligibility and Gold's breadth drops from 1.0, the precious-metals concentration would be fading; a confirmed negative score for Gold within 20 trading days would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the top-ranked eligible theme with the highest score (2.145), full breadth (1.0), not crowded (z=0.65), and a trend-gate that has historically helped control drawdown on Canada/TSX history. The lean is a direction on the prevailing leadership, justified primarily by the validated absolute-trend eligibility gate paired with confirmed durability (durability_bar 0.73). Momentum rank alone is not alpha; this is a stay-with-the-leader conditional, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has rank-IC ~0 on clean sectors, so the high score is an attention lens; leadership could mean-revert with no warning (Gold's r10 is slightly negative at -0.0664 and Hurst is mixed, showing recent chop).

falsifier.text: XGD.TO draws down more than the S&P/TSX benchmark over any rolling 10-trading-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the strongest challenger to Gold, eligible with score 1.998 and full breadth. Its Hurst tag is mean-revert, which cautions that short-term follow-through may be limited, but the trend-gate is satisfied and it is not crowded. Lean reflects the confirmed concentration in precious metals leadership rather than any predicted handoff — this is a companion conditional to the Gold lean, not a call that Silver overtakes Gold.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting Hurst and the absence of any validated rotation-timing edge mean the Silver-Gold margin (0.147) could invert quickly; following the challenger is not supported by a forward edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO proxy lags Gold Miners' XGD.TO by more than 5% cumulative over the next 25 trading days while both are eligible

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is ranked 3 and eligible, but carries the only crowding flag in the rotated set (crowded true, z=1.2) with below-full breadth (0.714). Crowding here is a size-down caution only, never a fade or sell — the absolute-trend gate has not excluded it, but the crowding texture plus the weak directional track record argues for standing aside rather than leaning in. This is an avoid, not a short.
theses.dissent: Energy remains a headline macro theme (n=3 in macro_narrative) and the trend-gate is satisfied, so crowding may simply reflect genuine flow rather than top-risk.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark and Gold Miners over the next 30 trading days while remaining uncrowded (z below 1.0)

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
